opening: I've had several seizures, and other people saw them.
Each one lasts less than a minute.
It began when I woke up with a headache, and then the seizures started.
I stay aware the whole time; I don't black out.
I woke up with a headache.
I have tingling and numbness on my left side.
I had a stroke before, in the right thalamus of the brain, and was treated with clot-busting medicine.
I had a single seizure during a previous hospital admission.
I've been taking levetiracetam since that seizure.

opening.text: I woke up with a headache and then started having several seizures that other people saw. Each one lasts less than a minute, and I stay aware the whole time; I don't black out. I also have tingling and numbness on my left side, and my left leg is weak. I had a stroke before in the right thalamus of the brain and was treated with clot-busting medicine. I had a single seizure during a previous hospital admission, and I've been taking levetiracetam since that seizure.
